description: Fork of exp611 (1.4048 SoTA, hybrid_smooth n_alt=1). SINGLE change: hybrid_smooth_n_alt=-1 (sentinel = use n_anchor_pairs per module) → forward now uses full Hamming-1 ball (NAP+1 rows: main + NAP single-bit-flip alternatives) instead of just 2 rows (main + alt at argmin |d|). Exact (NAP+1)-way softmax over row scores, derived analytically: Δts[k] = 2·|d[k]|/(T_soft + |d[k]|), logits = [0, -Δts/T_sel], probs = softmax(logits). No topk needed (all NAP positions used). Per-module NAP: qk_lut=4 → 5 rows; v_lut=6 → 7 rows; out_proj=6 → 7 rows; read_out_lut=5 → 6 rows. Weight grad scatters at all (NAP+1) rows scaled by their softmax probabilities. Input grad still uses soft K-row surrogate (backward 'as is' per user). Tests whether full Hamming-1 ball forward gives better gradient signal than 2-row variant.
